主要内容: Waters Corporation entered into a Credit Agreement dated June 25, 2013, with lenders, including JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as Administrative Agent. The agreement replaced its previous credit agreement, which matured in 2016 but was terminated early in 2013 without penalty. Under the new agreement, Waters secured a $300 million term loan and a $560 million revolving facility, totaling $860 million, to repay its previous obligations. The new Credit Agreement includes a five-year unsecured term loan and a $1.1 billion revolving facility. Waters Corporation disclosed updated terms for its Credit Agreement, including interest rate structures based on Alternate Base Rate or Adjusted LIBO Rate, with margins ranging from 0 to 12.5 basis points and 75 to 112.5 basis points respectively. The facility fee ranges between 12.5 and 25 basis points. The agreement mandates an interest coverage ratio of at least 3.50:1 and a leverage ratio not exceeding 3.50:1, similar to prior terms. Negative covenants and other provisions are customary for investment-grade credit facilities.
